title: Strong Fist Style
body:
Syntax: skills  (shows this skill's current proficiency; it's never used or practiced directly)

Description: A passive skill every character starts with. Unlike jutsu, it's never used directly -- it grows automatically from being in melee combat (never from 'practice'), and its proficiency percentage boosts your basic attack damage, up to +10% at 100% mastery.

Date: 2026-08-17
